tests: the phase diff credits every hunk to its own file: a quoted +++ header that also carries git's trailing TAB, and an added line that reads like a header

Recorded 2026-09-30 as the witness-hunks-quoted-tab case of the capture by the M6-P3 fix round 4 recording script, which builds the fixture with the commands the test's makeFixture runs; the named test re-runs both commands and requires git's live stdout to equal the recorded stdout before computePhaseDiff runs.
